draft_key_information_units.information: Subsidiary performance: LHV Pank net profit EUR 24.3 million (up 20% QoQ), loan portfolio growth EUR 114 million, deposits decline EUR 312 million; LHV Bank (UK) net profit EUR 1.4 million (up 12% QoQ), loan book EUR 945 million; LHV Varahaldus net profit EUR 0.4 million, assets under management EUR 1.79 billion; LHV Kindlustus net profit EUR 0.8 million, gross premiums EUR 11.7 million.

Major operational and strategic developments: LHV Pank migrated core banking systems to Amazon Web Services cloud environment, received MiCA crypto-asset service provider licence, commenced process to change business name to LHV Bank AS, and was recognised as best Estonian employer in financial sector; introduced Smart-ID+ service.

Loan impairment and portfolio quality: loan impairment charges increased to EUR 5.8 million in Q2 2026 (from EUR 1.3 million in Q1 2026), driven by forward-looking model provisions; loan portfolio collateral fair value exceeds book value by 3%; credit quality remains strong with low non-performing loan ratios.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial Summary and credit quality section (pages 4, 12-13).

evaluation.selection_rationale: These units cover material summary-level content: headline Q2 and H1 financial performance (D1, D2), balance sheet position and capital/liquidity ratios (D3), performance versus plan (D4), subsidiary results (D5), strategic operational developments (D6), and impairment/portfolio quality (D7). They represent independently omittable themes aligned with the priority areas (financial performance, period changes, drivers, segments, liquidity, strategy). Boilerplate topics (governance, risk lists, accounting policies) are excluded per requirements. The units are supported exclusively by the source report and reflect salience indicated in the reference summary.
